reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 3 recyclers trading the same material (23% of its feedstock)
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 3 other plant(s)
67% of all certificates were generated in a single month
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.48x the cost floor)
67% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month
97% of product sales go to buyers incorporated under a year before the invoice

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
